newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-ROUND TROON WITH TIGER WOODS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ROUND TROON WITH TIGER WOODS.

text.p: Tiger Woods saved par after visiting two bunkers in a spectacular start to his British Open challenge on Thursday.

The 21-year-old world number one drove into a greenside bunker on the left side of the 364-yard first and had to blast out awkwardly with his right leg in the sand and the other with knee bent on the grass.The shot sailed straight across the green into another bunker.
But he pitched from there to six feet and holed for four.
Woods parred the next two as well. He drove to the left side of the second fairway then just missed another greenside bunker with his approach. From the edge of the green he putted to one foot.
The wind carried his drive into the rough on the right side of the third fairway but he pitched up to 20 feet from where his birdie putt just slid by the hole, leaving him with a routine par.

Woods unleashed a mighty drive of over 400 yards at the 557- yard par-five fourth and needed a short iron into the green, where he two-putted from 12 feet for a birdie, his eagle attempt hitting the edge of the hole.
His tee shot at the 210-yard fifth went through the green but he chipped back to two feet and holed for par.
He collected his second birdie at the 577-yard sixth, the longest hole on the Open Championship rota of courses.
He did not murder his drive like he had at the fourth and his long-iron second finished on a greenside bank.
Woods pitched to the edge of the green and the ball rolled nicely down to two feet for a birdie four. He was two under par through six holes.
